shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && printf '\\n--- PACKAGE ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- APP ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && printf '\\n--- MAIN ---\\n' && sed -n '1,160p' src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit@latest version peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit versions --json | tail -40'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | sed -n '1,220p'; printf '\\n--- DOCS ---\\n'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null || true; printf '\\n--- EXPORTS ---\\n'; rg -n \"export (declare )?(function|class|const|type|interface)\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/dist/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/dist/**/*.d.ts | head -100"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '220,520p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md; printf '\\n--- PKG ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | head -120; printf '\\n--- FILES ---\\n'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | rg 'docs|README|\\.d\\.ts"'$'"' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- TYPES ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts; printf '\\n--- PLUGINS ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- SETTINGS ---\\n'; rg -n \"interface SettingsProps|type SettingsProps|DashKitDnDWrapper|ActionPanel\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/index.d.ts; printf '\\n--- TEXT ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts; printf '\\n--- TITLE ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts; printf '\\n--- COMPONENTS ---\\n'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/index.js; sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.js; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/constants.js; printf '\\n--- DND README ---\\n'; sed -n '500,680p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '380,490p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; printf '\\n--- THEME SETUP ---\\n'; sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md; printf '\\n--- LAYOUT ---\\n'; sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/layout.md | rg -n \"Flex|Box|direction|justify|align|gap\" -C 2 | head -120; rg -n \"export declare const Flex|interface FlexProps|type Flex\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"plugin =|type: 'title'|defaultLayout\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.js -C 4; printf '\\n--- MENU CONST ---\\n'; rg -n \"MenuItems\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/constants -g '*.d.ts' -C 10; printf '\\n--- DROP TYPE ---\\n'; rg -n \"ItemDropProps\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/shared/types -g '*.d.ts' -C 8"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.css | head -100; cat package.json; git status --short 2>/dev/null || true"

/bin/bash -lc "nl -ba src/widgets/Dashboard.tsx | sed -n '1,190p'; printf '\\n--- METRIC ---\\n'; nl -ba src/widgets/MetricWidget.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- NOTE ---\\n'; nl -ba src/widgets/NoteWidget.tsx | sed -n '1,80p'; printf '\\n--- APP ---\\n'; nl -ba src/App.tsx"
